quests.title: The Missing Ledger
quests.description: The archivist has asked for help finding a misplaced ledger. This is an original demonstration quest, not a quest from Another Chance.
quests.rewards: The archivist agrees to introduce you to the archive staff. No inventory reward is granted by the script.

stages.title: Ask the archivist
stages.description: Find out where the ledger was last seen.

objectives.text: Ask the archivist where the ledger was last seen.

stages.title: Search the reading room
stages.description: Look for the ledger in the location the archivist identified.

stages.title: Return the ledger
stages.description: Bring the recovered ledger back to the archivist.

objectives.text: Hand the ledger to the archivist.

quests.title: An Archive Errand
quests.description: After the ledger is returned, the archivist can offer a small sorting job.
quests.rewards: An established favor from the archive staff.

objectives.text: Sort a box of records into the correct shelves.

quests.title: The Courier's Favor
quests.description: A courier in the square has a parcel to deliver. This independent demonstration branch is available from the start.
quests.rewards: The courier's promised introduction, if honored in the story.

objectives.text: Deliver the courier's parcel to the named recipient.

quests.title: Beyond the Public Shelves
quests.description: The next archive quest requires the ledger to be returned and either the archive errand or the courier's favor to be completed.
quests.rewards: Reference only: any access must still be established in the story.

objectives.text: Arrange an appointment with the senior archivist.
